changelog.notes: Schema 2.0. Block renamed to site. Harmonised variable names, units and English descriptions. Country and crop added to site data. Administrative names kept as adm1 to adm3. Coordinates checked against country borders. Genotype spellings merged: Uyole03  (Check) -> Uyole03 (Check)

location_privacy.method: Site coordinates rounded to two decimals (a cell of about 1.1 km), so the published point lies within 800 m of the recorded one and neighbouring sites share a point.
location_privacy.admin_names: Administrative names kept as adm1 to adm3, capitalisation standardised

genotypes.remarks: Rejected by TOSCI, it need futher improvement

funder.awardTitle: Accelerated Varietal Improvement and Seed Delivery of Legumes and Cereals in Africa – AVISA

variables.description: Site identifier, trial id plus package number
Trial identifier. ClimMob v3 project id, or for legacy trials 11 hex characters plus 'v' (see decisions)
Country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code
Country name
Crop tested in the trial
Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84), rounded to two decimals to protect participants
Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84), rounded to two decimals to protect participants
Where the original coordinate was taken (farm, interview point, adm3 mean of other sites, missing, removed)
Radius in metres around the published point that contains the original point (displacement plus spread of the sites used for gap filling)
Check of the original coordinate against the country boundary (ok, near_border, missing, outside, swapped_candidate, sign_flip_candidate)
Age of the participant in years at registration
Gender of the participant
Please select your highest degree obtained
Please indicate your civil status
Second level administrative unit of the country
Name of the place below the lowest administrative level (village, community)
Please indicate how many years you have growing the crop?
On which day did you do the assessment of your trial plot?
Was your trial package delivered on time?
Planting date (YYYY-MM-DD)

Is any of these options different between your trial plot and the main field?
What equipment was used for land preparation?

What is the unit used the measure the plot size

Did you find any disease in the trial?

If different management, which one did you provide better management?

Did you use fertilizers on your tricot trial?
Did you use pesticides on your tricot trial?
If seeds were available for all three options, which option(s) would you like to grow in the next season?
What is the main occupation of the respondent?
For how many years did you attend school?
Is the respondent able to read in English?
Is the respondent able to read in the local language?
What is the type of household?
